response.rationale: Both forms mean details used to contact a person. “Informasi kontak” is ordinary Indonesian, while Malaysian Malay commonly uses the more formal “maklumat perhubungan”; this is a useful variety difference, not exclusive ownership.
response.risk_rationale: The Malaysian form is somewhat formal and may vary with context, but it remains ordinary and understandable.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Malaysian Malay may also use “butiran hubungan” or “maklumat hubungan,” but “maklumat perhubungan” remains a credible standard/formal preference; Indonesian commonly favors “informasi kontak.”
